rows.grounds: compound epithet: tārā-gaṇa-kṛta-āgārā; describes one whose dwelling is made or formed by multitudes of stars
compound epithet: tārā-gaṇa-nata-tparā; describes one devoted to or supreme among the bowing multitudes of stars

items.question: What dwelling and devotional orientation define the goddess in relation to star multitudes?
premises: The goddess is characterized as having an abode made by multitudes of stars.
The goddess is characterized as devoted to or supreme among bowing multitudes of stars.
items.inference: The goddess is both cosmically situated among star multitudes and oriented toward their reverent devotion.
uncertainties: The exact sense of natatparā (devoted to the bowed or intent on bowing) is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: She whose abode is made by multitudes of stars, and who is devoted to the bowing multitudes of stars.
